uncovered_constraints_packaged: R05 validates the immutable same-run cumulative runtime ledger containing exactly R01,R02,R03,R04, every direct handoff byte, and every transitive business hash before offline work.
R05 is strictly offline: it starts no service, imports no HIP-initializing target module, runs no model, uses no GPU/DCU, invokes no profiler, collects no trace, and replays no PMC counter.
The complete batch8 contract is explicit: eight ordered 16-32K requests, concurrency eight, infinite request rate, 1024 output tokens, two excluded warmups, temperature zero, and ignored EOS.
Every input and output preserves physical devices 0 and 1, ranks 0 and 1, the 0-to-0 and 1-to-1 mapping, world size two, TP1, PP1, and DP2 mp; serial ordering cannot promote one-device data.
R01 is the only full-layer timing denominator, R02 owns current process and fragment structure, R03 owns direct non-replay process timing and order, and R04 owns replay hardware diagnostics only.
R02's no-profiler fields, R03's native launch-owned evidence, and R04's timing_collection_performed=false and pmc_replay_treated_as_latency=false fields are independently checked.
All R01-R04 inputs resolve through scheduler handoffs and artifact manifests; ambient files, historical backups, copied reports, prior runs, and Adapt handoffs are not runtime evidence.

Current Qwen linear-attention and full-attention process taxonomies remain separate; fragments aggregate only by the R02 aggregation key, and unresolved, ambiguous, metadata, and no-kernel rows stay visible.
Canonical groups retain runtime run, request, forward, DP rank, native device, layer type, phase, layer, occurrence, shape, metric, process, fragment, and row-hash provenance.
observed_fx_op is reserved for exact conserving direct R03 rows; every normalization to a target R01 metric is template_scaled and retains the representative observed amount separately.
Production matching is exact on request, rank/device, layer type, phase, q_len, kv_len, metric, and source bucket; exact-or-nearest remains a separately labeled sensitivity mode.
Family-aware and component-total split modes plus semantic-cost and node-count weight modes are preserved, but nonproduction alternatives remain under sensitivity with projected evidence labels.
All weight creation, normalization, allocation, summation, residual placement, and tolerance checks remain inside a precision-60-or-greater Decimal localcontext with a 1e-50 threshold.

The independent auditor does not import generator grouping or allocation logic and separately recomputes denominator-group count, target occurrences, detail leaf rows, assignments, evidence classes, unmatched and ambiguous counts, maximum error, and full rank/device coverage.
Formal JSON, CSV, SHA-256, report, and conservation validation uses Python standard-library implementations and never requires jq.
The seven Workflow 04 output basenames are emitted under runtime_artifact_root with Qwen batch8 DP2 native evidence columns and explicit compatibility aliases.

The main report exposes denominators, template assignments, per-occurrence attribution, aggregation, coverage/risk, and hardware interpretation; the compatibility breakdown preserves the reference five-heading report shape.
R04 joins only by exact R03 target, process or fragment, kernel family, request, rank, device, and hashes; replay time, replay order, proximity, and kernel name cannot affect timing.
Turn liveness requires four simultaneously stagnant signals for a recorded window of at least 300 seconds; a live app-server or state heartbeat alone is not progress.
Interruption targets only a cmdline-verified scheduler PID, never a shared PTY or process group; continue-current is allowed only after a confirmed clean pause.

Recovery distinguishes an empty R05 root from partial business files, uses the exact constrained resume-artifact-root, records abandoned attempts, and revalidates ledger, handoffs, source anchors, target clean state, and all hashes.
A pre-output Decimal failure isolates its old input manifest and records old and new generator and auditor hashes; it never weakens precision or conservation and never changes R01-R04.
Every helper revision and failed attempt is immutable, and valid predecessor bytes are reused for an R05-only offline defect without any model or collection rerun.

Business artifacts stay under runtime_artifact_root and the single scheduler handoff stays at runtime_handoff_output; R06 cannot start before complete, full-coverage, hash-valid R05 handoff validation.
